items.title: FAQs
items.html:
Can I buy a single flavor once I discover my favorite?
Absolutely! Once you know which flavor your family loves most, feel free to purchase it individually—or explore it in our mouthwash, floss, or mouth spray, too.
Is this bundle suitable for both children and adults?
Yes! Our hydroxyapatite-based formula is crafted for all ages—delicious for kids, powerful enough for grown-ups.
Why do some people choose non-fluoride toothpaste?
Some individuals may opt for non-fluoride toothpaste due to concerns about excessive fluoride intake, allergies, or personal preferences. However, it's important to consult with your dentist to determine if this choice aligns with your individual dental health needs.
What is non-fluoride toothpaste?
Non-fluoride toothpaste (or non-fluoridated toothpaste) is defined as any toothpaste that doesn't contain fluoride. SuperMouth offers hydroxyapatite toothpaste both with and without fluoride.
What is hydroxyapatite in oral care products?
Hydroxyapatite in oral care products is a naturally occurring mineral form of calcium apatite, similar to human tooth enamel. It’s used to promote remineralization, helping to restore and protect the enamel surface of the teeth.
Is hydroxyapatite better than fluoride?
Hydroxyapatite and fluoride have distinct benefits for oral health. Fluoride, recognized by the FDA for cavity prevention and teeth strengthening, differs from hydroxyapatite, which is known for its enamel compatibility. Hydroxyapatite can form a protective layer on teeth, potentially helping against erosion and reducing sensitivity.
What’s the difference between micro and nano-hydroxyapatite, and why does SuperMouth use the nano version?
The difference lies in particle size. Nano-hydroxyapatite has much smaller particles compared to micro-hydroxyapatite. SuperMouth uses nano-hydroxyapatite because its smaller particles are more effective at penetrating and coating tooth enamel for enhanced remineralization and protection.
What is Hydroxamin in SuperMouth products?
Hydroxamin is SuperMouth’s unique formulation combining nano-hydroxyapatite, vitamin D3, and vitamin K2. It’s designed to offer a balanced approach to oral health, ensuring each ingredient is at an ideal concentration for maximum efficiency. Nano-hydroxyapatite is similar to the natural building blocks of teeth, providing support for enamel. Vitamin D3 assists in the healthy development of teeth and bones, and vitamin K2 helps in the proper utilization of calcium. This synergistic effect aims to enhance oral health comprehensively.

items.title: HOW TO USE
items.html:
• Pick any flavor—from crisp mint to sweet chocolate.
  • Squeeze a pea-sized amount onto your toothbrush.
  • Brush thoroughly for two minutes (before breakfast and before bedtime).
  • Rotate flavors anytime to keep brushing fun—just like sampling new scoops at the ice cream parlor!
  • Feeling creative? Mix two flavors for a delicious “ice cream swirl” experience—think chocolate and mint for a refreshing twist!
